title: Tamsin and the Crown
author: Astrid Thornbury
blurb: Rosalind Brightwater, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
